raw_comment:
I noticed that there isn’t an overall theme and just some random spots that don’t correlate well.

I wonder if global warming is causing the droughts or if a different interaction is causing them. I really just wonder what causes them. It seems there is no common theme among the various environments.

This relates to me and the people around me because this is my country. And to see people in droughts is something different. And it even shows Michigan as a somewhat affected area.

“Can’t Doubt That There Really is Droughts”
